user_profile_lengths_ck.name: user_profile_lengths_ck
user_profile_lengths_ck.value: char_length("user_profile"."role") <= 100 and char_length("user_profile"."team") <= 100 and char_length("user_profile"."about") <= 1000 and coalesce(array_length("user_profile"."vocabulary", 1), 0) <= 100

chunk_segment_range_ck.name: chunk_segment_range_ck
chunk_segment_range_ck.value: ("chunk"."segment_start_ms" is null) = ("chunk"."segment_end_ms" is null) and ("chunk"."segment_start_ms" is null or "chunk"."segment_end_ms" >= "chunk"."segment_start_ms")

enhancement_completed_ck.name: enhancement_completed_ck
enhancement_completed_ck.value: "enhancement"."status" <> 'completed' or ("enhancement"."output_json" is not null and "enhancement"."completed_at" is not null)
